title: Cleaning rota
brief:
KODEX: Facilities' cleaning rota. You're the janitor; this is technically your job.

Show area, item and notes for every task that starts with 'Special' (use LIKE).
successMessage: The conference room plant needs a 'special clean': staff hide coins in the soil. Somebody's going to need a janitor.

cells: Do NOT tip out the soil. Sift it. Staff keep 'emergency' coins in this one.
He checks it with a white glove.
